name: io.github.extensiondev/mcp
title: extension.dev MCP
description: Build, run, debug, test and ship Chrome, Firefox, Edge and Safari extensions from your AI agent.

packageArguments.name: --features
packageArguments.description: Tool groups to expose. local is everything that runs on this machine; platform adds the extension.dev tools that share, release and submit to the stores, which need a login; extras adds the theme check and the network stubs.

packageArguments.name: --project
packageArguments.description: Pin the server to one extension.dev project, so only that project's login is used.

packageArguments.name: --no-ship
packageArguments.description: A flag with no value. Refuses every call that puts something in front of other people: publish, promote, a real store submit, a share link or a share revoke. EXTENSION_DEV_NO_SHIP=1 does the same.

environmentVariables.name: EXTENSION_DEV_FEATURES
environmentVariables.description: Same as --features: the tool groups to expose.

environmentVariables.name: EXTENSION_DEV_NO_SHIP
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to refuse every call that puts something in front of other people: publish, promote, a real store submit, a share link or a share revoke. The --no-ship flag does the same.

environmentVariables.name: EXTENSION_DEV_PROJECT
environmentVariables.description: Same as --project: pin the server to one extension.dev project.

environmentVariables.name: EXTENSION_DEV_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: An extension.dev access token the platform tools send in place of the device login, for CI.

environmentVariables.name: EXTENSION_DEV_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the extension.dev platform the platform tools and docs search call, an extension.dev host or a local development server. Unset: https://www.extension.dev.

environmentVariables.name: EXTENSION_DEV_NO_AUTO_OPEN
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to stop the server from opening the approval page in the default browser when a platform act needs a human approval.

environmentVariables.name: EXTENSION_DEV_NO_TELEMETRY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to send no telemetry (the one scaffold event and the per-install id header). DO_NOT_TRACK=1 does the same.

environmentVariables.name: DO_NOT_TRACK
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to send no telemetry, the same as EXTENSION_DEV_NO_TELEMETRY=1.

environmentVariables.name: EXTENSION_MCP_CLI_VERSION
environmentVariables.description: The Extension.js engine version to run when the project has none of its own. Unset: the version this release pins.

environmentVariables.name: EXTENSION_MCP_ENGINE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Run every engine command from this compiled Extension.js checkout instead of the published engine.

environmentVariables.name: EXTENSION_MCP_ENGINE_BIN
environmentVariables.description: Run every engine command from this one engine bin file instead of the published engine.

environmentVariables.name: EXTENSION_HEADLESS
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to launch every browser the server starts headless, unless a call passes headless: false.

environmentVariables.name: EXTENSION_BROWSER_FLAGS
environmentVariables.description: Extra command line flags for every browser the engine starts, separated by spaces. A --headless flag here counts as EXTENSION_HEADLESS=1.

environmentVariables.name: EXT_BROWSERS_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder that holds the managed browsers extension_browsers_install installs. Unset: the per-user extension.js browsers cache.

environmentVariables.name: EXTENSION_MCP_SESSION_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder for the running sessions' state files. Unset: extension-dev-mcp-sessions in the system temporary folder.

environmentVariables.name: EXTENSION_TRY_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder where extension_try unpacks a published build. Unset: extension-try in the system temporary folder.

environmentVariables.name: EXTENSION_ISOLATED_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder for isolated runs, which build and open a copy of the project. Unset: extension-isolated in the system temporary folder.

environmentVariables.name: EXTENSION_KEEP_SOCKET_PROCESS
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 on Linux to keep Firefox's socket process when the engine is older than 4.3.0, where the server turns it off by default.
